title: Classic Bruschetta
tip: Toast slices of bread, rub with garlic, top with diced tomato, basil, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.

title: Cheesy Toast
tip: Butter bread, place cheese on top, broil until melted and golden; serve hot.

title: Quick Tzatziki
tip: Grate cucumber, mix with yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, dill, and salt; chill before serving.

title: Rice and Bean Bowl
tip: Combine cooked rice and beans, season with cumin, lime juice, salt, and pepper; top with chopped cilantro.

title: Ham & Egg Breakfast Sandwich
tip: Fry an egg, layer on bread or English muffin with ham and cheese; toast until cheese melts.

title: Fresh Salad
tip: Chop tomato, onion, and cucumber; toss with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.

title: French Toast
tip: Whisk egg with a splash of milk, dip bread slices, and fry until golden; dust with cinnamon sugar.

title: Simple Chicken Soup
tip: Simmer chicken in broth with chopped onion and carrot; season with salt, pepper, and parsley.

title: Egg Fried Rice
tip: Scramble egg, add cooked rice and soy sauce; stir-fry with chopped scallions.

title: Tomato Cheese Bruschetta
tip: Top toasted bread with sliced tomato and melted cheese; finish with basil and olive oil.
